evidence.title: £500m Share Buyback and £150m Employee Share Plan Funding

initiatives.name: Win as One Strategic Framework
initiatives.summary: Haleon launched a new strategic framework called 'Win as One' aimed at unlocking the company's full potential through consistent growth, productivity gains, and an agile performance-focused culture. The strategy includes two ambitions: reaching one billion more consumers by 2030 and generating industry-leading shareholder returns.

evidence.title: New Operating Model with Chief Growth and Transformation Officer Roles
evidence.summary: In early 2026, Haleon announced an evolution of its operating model to support its 'Win as One' strategy, including creation of a Chief Growth Officer role, a Chief Transformation Officer position, and establishment of six Operating Units to enhance growth, productivity and organisational agility.
evidence.quote: In early 2026, we announced the evolution of our operating model to support our Win as One strategy. This included creating a Chief Growth Officer role and a Chief Transformation Officer position, and establishing six Operating Units to enhance growth, productivity and organisational agility.

evidence.title: New Operating Model with Chief Growth Officer and Six Operating Units
evidence.summary: Haleon announced a new operating model to drive growth and agility in support of its Win as One strategy, including the creation of a new Chief Growth Officer role and six new Operating Units on the Executive Team. This is designed to bring consumer insights deeper into strategic decision-making and enable better investment choices and execution.
evidence.quote: In January 2026, we announced plans to evolve our operating model to drive growth and agility in support of our Win as One ambitions. This included creating a new Chief Growth Officer role to lead our growth and innovation agenda alongside the creation of six new Operating Units, which all sit on the Haleon Executive Team, bringing the voice of consumers deeper into strategic decision making.

evidence.title: Launch of Win as One Strategy
evidence.summary: Haleon launched a new strategic framework called 'Win as One' aimed at unlocking the company's full potential through consistent growth, productivity gains, and an agile performance-focused culture. The strategy includes two ambitions: reaching one billion more consumers by 2030 and generating industry-leading shareholder returns.
evidence.quote: In May, we launched our new Win as One strategy, a bold and ambitious plan to unlock our full potential. We are focused on delivering three strategic priorities: delivering consistent growth, unlocking productivity gains and embedding an agile, performance-focused culture.

initiatives.name: Supply Chain Productivity Programme
initiatives.summary: Haleon is targeting £800 million in gross supply chain savings over five years by reducing SKUs, packaging and formulations by around 30%, increasing multi-sourcing of ingredients to around 90%, and optimising logistics, engineering and manufacturing footprint. This supply chain transformation is driving gross margin expansion.

evidence.title: £800m Gross Supply Chain Productivity Savings Programme
evidence.summary: Haleon is targeting £800 million in gross supply chain savings over five years by reducing SKUs, packaging and formulations by around 30%, increasing multi-sourcing of ingredients to around 90%, and optimising logistics, engineering and manufacturing footprint. This supply chain transformation is driving gross margin expansion.
evidence.quote: We aim to unlock £800m in gross supply chain savings over the next five years through optimising our supply chain, allowing us to deliver operating leverage more consistently to the bottom line.

evidence.title: Sustainability Guidance for Suppliers and Carbon Pricing Scheme
evidence.summary: Haleon launched a Sustainability Guidance for Suppliers Document and implemented a carbon pricing scheme (following EU ETS carbon cost) that converts supplier carbon emissions into commercial value for supplier selection, encouraging decarbonisation across its supply chain.
evidence.quote: In 2024, Haleon implemented a carbon pricing scheme that converts carbon emissions into a commercial value for supplier selection criteria. This mechanism encourages suppliers to reduce their carbon footprint to make themselves more competitive. Haleon's carbon price follows the EU ETS cost of carbon.

initiatives.name: Net Zero Carbon Emissions Commitment
initiatives.summary: Haleon aims to achieve net zero carbon emissions from source to sale by 2040, aligned with guidance from the Climate Pledge and Race to Zero, alongside interim targets to reduce Scope 1 and 2 emissions by 100% and Scope 3 by 42% by 2030.

evidence.title: Net Zero Carbon Emissions Target by 2040
evidence.summary: Haleon aims to achieve net zero carbon emissions from source to sale by 2040, aligned with guidance from the Climate Pledge and Race to Zero, alongside interim targets to reduce Scope 1 and 2 emissions by 100% and Scope 3 by 42% by 2030.
evidence.quote: We aim to achieve net zero carbon emissions from source to sale by 20405. We have implemented key policies to support this goal, including our Buying Goods and Services Policy, which covers not only the requirements for carbon pricing in tenders but also the sustainable procurement of agricultural, marine and forest derived materials.

evidence.title: Scope 1 & 2 Carbon Emissions Reduced 55% vs 2020 Baseline
evidence.summary: Haleon achieved a 55% net reduction in Scope 1 and 2 carbon emissions versus its 2020 baseline in 2025, driven by renewable electricity use, decarbonisation of manufacturing, and energy efficiency projects, progressing toward its 100% reduction target by 2030.
evidence.quote: The Company achieved a 55%* net reduction in Scope 1 and 2 carbon emissions vs the 2020 baseline. This was driven by a continued focus on renewable electricity, decarbonisation of manufacturing operations, and targeted energy efficiency projects.

initiatives.name: Historical Non-Strategic Brand Portfolio Exit
